meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 lsp 工具在当前工作区查代码:跑语言服务器诊断、跳转到定义、查找引用、列出符号,以及校验并应用重命名。语言服务器在 .codex/lsp-client.json 里配置。
howto.when: 当当前工作区需要语言服务器诊断、定义跳转、引用查找等能力时由它接管。

say.text: 对这个文件跑 lsp.diagnostics,只看 error
say.note: 会检查该文件的 LSP 诊断,按 error 过滤

say.text: 找出 foo 这个符号在整个工作区里的引用
say.note: 会调用 find_references 列出所有使用位置

say.text: 把 utils.ts 第 12 行那个函数重命名成 bar
say.note: 先校验重命名是否合法,再应用到工作区

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use lsp MCP tools on your workspace: run diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and check or apply renames. Servers are configured in .codex/lsp-client.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the current workspace needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks.

say_en.text: Run lsp.diagnostics on this file, errors only
say_en.note: Checks LSP diagnostics for that file, filtered to errors

say_en.text: Find every reference to the symbol foo across the workspace
say_en.note: Calls find_references and lists all usage sites

say_en.text: Rename the function on line 12 of utils.ts to bar
say_en.note: Checks the rename is valid, then applies it workspace-wide
